No. 1981/28– MONDAY,AUGUST, 22, 2016
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
Ref. No.: WLP/LAN/4/ACQ/04. Land Ministry Reference No.: 4-3/12/2013ED/512.

I hereby give notice under Sub section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land / servitude which is required for the public purpose mentioned below.

Description of the land to be acquired: Following allotments of lands (07) containing in total extent 2.8549 hectare depicted in the survey plan bearing No. 2656 dated 14.07.2016 made by Surveyor General, situated in the Grama Niladari Division of 375 B Sahabandu Kokmaduwa in Divisional Secretary’s Division of Welipitiya, Matara District, Southern Province.

1. Lot No. 1 Name of the land: Delgahawela Kumbura; Description: Marshy land, paddy field; Claimants: Heirs of deceased Jinadasa Kodithuwakkuge, Sayakkara Jayaweera Kankanamge Richord and others, Kokmaduwa, Weligama; Extent: 2.3117 Hectare.

2. Lot No. 2 Name of the land: Delgahawela Kumbura and Mohottiwila; Description: paddy field; Claimants: Kodithuwakkuge Udayasiri, Heirs of deceased Jinadasa Kodithuwakkuge, Sayakkara Jayaweera Kankanamge Richord and others, Kokmaduwa, Weligama; Extent: 0.2906 Hectare.

3. Lot No. 3 Name of the land: Delgahawela Kumbura; Description: Marshy land, paddy field; Claimants: Heirs of deceased Jinadasa Kodithuwakkuge, Sayakkara Jayaweera Kankanamge Richord and others, Kokmaduwa, Weligama; Extent: 0.2305 Hectare.
4. Lot No. 4 Name of the land: Ketapitiya Kumbura; Description: paddy field; Claimants: Sayakkara Jayaweera Kankanamge Seethawathi, Kokmaduwa, Weligama; Extent: 0.0085 Hectare.
5. Lot No. 5 Name of the land: —; Description: Pradeshiya Sabha Road; Claimants: Sayakkara Jayaweera Kankanamge Seethawathi, Kokmaduwa, Weligama; Extent: 0.0012 Hectare.
6. Lot No. 6 Name of the land: —; Description: Canal; Claimants: State; Extent: 0.0106 Hectare.

All Persons interested in the aforesaid land/ lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretariat of Welipitiya on the 07th day of October, 2016 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 30th day of September 2016 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
THUSHARI P. SOORIYAARACHCHI, Divisional Secretary, Welipitiya.

THE LAND ACQUISITION (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
Land Ministry’s Ref. No.: 4-3/9/2013/WS474.

I hereby give notice, under sub section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the land acquisition (Amendment) Act., No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose.

Description of the land to be acquired: An allotment of land of about 0.4274 hectare in extent depicted as lot 351 in Final Village Plan No.25, prepared by Surveyor General, situated at Rajjammana Village in Gampahasiya pattuwa minor Division, of Matale Divisional Secretary’s Division, Matale District, Central province. And bounded as follows;
Lot No. 351 Name of land: Rajjammana Plantation; Original Ownership: Halgahawatta Walawwe Gunapala;
North: Lots 348; East: Lot 348 & 349; South: Lot 139 & 152; West: Lot 132.

All Person interested in the aforesaid land on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Matale Divisional Secretariat on the 26th day of Sep. 2016 at 2.00 p.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 19th day of Sep. 2016 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
K.P.K.L.P.MADHUWANTHI, Divisional Secretary, Matale Division, Matale District. Divisional Secretariat, Matale. 15th August 2016 09 - 236
